key_idea: Encode the coloring problem as a Boolean satisfiability formula and use a massively parallel SAT solver with cube-and-conquer to exhaustively rule out all possibilities.
reason: This is the quintessential brute-force computer proof, relying entirely on exhaustive search and a 200-terabyte machine-generated certificate. It yields absolutely no human-understandable reason why the critical threshold occurs at 7825.
recognized: Heule, Kullmann, and Marek (2016) on the Boolean Pythagorean Triples problem
